A negro man, Brishari bin Brubarak, by name and whose age is 60 years has come here to complain from his master Brubarak bin Abdul Aziz bin Nasir.
He says that his father Brubarak was not a slave and that his son Brishari was captured by Mutair and from that time had been sold to various masters.
He has come here soliciting the government to kindly free him from his master.
